filterSchema.label: Interface language
filterSchema.notes: ln sets the UI language; language of full text is filtered by fulltext filename suffix (-EN.pdf etc.), not by a query param.

filterSchema.label: Collection code
filterSchema.notes: Invenio collection selector; value list not verifiable through the WAF. Left unconstrained for the general UNDL source.

filterSchema.label: Sort field
filterSchema.notes: sf=year with so=d for descending; documented Invenio params, not live-verifiable (search endpoint WAF-gated).

responseMapping.title: title.title
responseMapping.note: recjson field names per Invenio 1.x; endpoint is WAF-challenged in server-to-server calls so mapping is documented, not byte-verified. MARCXML export is the reliable metadata channel — see enrich.

download.notes: Filenames come from MARC 856$u. Non-ASCII / parenthesised symbols are URL-encoded (space->_, ( -> %28, ) -> %29), e.g. S_RES_2321_%282016%29-EN.pdf. Request returns 302 to /nanna/record/{recid}/files/{filename}?withWatermark=0&registerDownload=1 which serves Content-Type: application/pdf. Language variants: -EN -FR -ES -AR -RU -ZH (and sometimes -DE). Verified 200/application/pdf on record 850022.

enrich.notes: Returns MARC21 slim XML (Content-Type text/xml, HTTP 200), WAF-safe with a browser User-Agent. Confirmed fields: 191 (a=symbol, b=series, c=session, q=normalized), 245 (title), 260/269 (date), 650 (UNBIS subjects, $2 unbist), 610/710/981 (bodies), 856 (file URLs per language), 989 (collection hierarchy), 991 (related docs), 996 (voting note, on resolution records). Trailing '?' is required to reach the export handler cleanly.

methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The UN Digital Library (UNDL) is the UN Secretariat's Invenio-based catalogue of documents, voting records, speeches and publications from 1946 onward. This general source covers the whole collection; sibling ODS sources scope it to specific organ symbol prefixes.

## Search
Search is the Invenio endpoint `https://digitallibrary.un.org/search` with the free-text/field query in `p` and `of=recjson` for JSON output. Invenio field syntax applies: `191__a:"S/RES/2321 (2016)"` for document symbol, `650__a:"PEACEBUILDING"` for subjects, `710__a:"UN. Secretary-General"` for body, `year:2020` (or `year:2019->2021`) for date. Boolean `AND`/`OR`/`NOT` and phrase quoting are supported.

## Filters
Collection is selected with `c=`; interface language with `ln=`; sort with `sf` (field) + `so` (a/d). Full-text language is not a query filter — it is chosen at download time via the filename suffix.

## Pagination
Offset-1 style: `jrec` is the 1-based index of the first record (1, then rg+1, ...) and `rg` is the page size. So page N of size R uses `jrec=(N-1)*R+1&rg=R`.

## Download
PDFs live at `/record/{recid}/files/{filename}`; prefer the `-EN.pdf` variant. The URL 302-redirects to a `/nanna/...` signed URL that returns `application/pdf`.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Per-record full metadata is the MARC21 XML export at `/record/{recid}/export/xm?` — the reliable, WAF-safe channel. It carries symbol (191), title (245), subjects (650), bodies (610/710/981), files (856), collection (989) and voting (996).

## Limitations
The `/search` endpoint is behind an AWS WAF that answers server-to-server requests with HTTP 202 `x-amzn-waf-action: challenge`; a JS/browser challenge must be solved to retrieve result lists. The record `export/xm` and `files` paths are not challenged. OAI-PMH is present but exposes only a `sanctions` set, so it is not a general harvest path.
probeNotes: Live-probed 2026-07-03. GET /search?p=resolution&of=recjson (also of=xm) -> HTTP 202, header x-amzn-waf-action: challenge, 0-byte body (AWS WAF challenge; recjson not directly harvestable). GET /record/855111/export/xm? -> 200 text/xml, full MARC21 (record was A/71/630, SG report). GET /record/850022/export/xm? -> 200, 12KB MARC for S/RES/2321(2016): 191__a="S/RES/2321 (2016)", 245 title, seven 856 file URLs (AR/ZH/EN/FR/RU/ES/DE), 996__a="Adopted unanimously, 7821st meeting". HEAD /record/850022/files/S_RES_2321_%282016%29-EN.pdf -> 302 to /nanna/... -> 200 application/pdf 387677 bytes. OAI Identify 200; ListSets exposes only setSpec 'sanctions'. Search param semantics (jrec/rg/sf/so/c) are standard Invenio 1.x, documented but not byte-verified due to the WAF.
